resources.string: Shows while OpenGuard is tracking this device.
Your location is being recorded. Tap to open OpenGuard, or stop tracking anytime.
You sent a Ring command. Tap Stop to silence it, or unlock the phone.
This phone is marked as lost. Tap to see the owner message.
Check if this was you — open OpenGuard to review.
This phone will be erased in 60 seconds. Tap to abort.
Lets OpenGuard lock this phone when you send a Lock or Lost Mode command, and erase it when you send an Erase command.

OpenGuard uses device admin only to lock this phone when you send a Lock or Lost Mode command, and to erase it when you send an Erase command. It never sets or changes your password, and you can remove it anytime from Settings.
